runs.scope: Initial v35 subset, before adding the production learning-rate-prefix test
Final full suite, including all 15 v35 tests

verification.warnings: Two existing PyTorch nested-tensor warnings in older model tests; no failures.
model_and_selection_checks: Actual width-192 balanced attention with 5016 outputs and rare residual head has finite forward and backward passes
Per-survey ranking objective handles normalized soft targets and empty-label rows
All 15 policies produce valid full species sets and bounded cardinalities
Cached comparator rejects changed labels, species order, split-role identities and calibration scores
Policy selection cannot inspect assessment and rejects a v34-sized gain or a negative fold
Selected production epoch transfer preserves the development cosine-schedule prefix and never queries selection labels
runtime_and_pipeline: GPU and official-metadata identity checks precede expensive feature loading
Remaining-plan admission includes full first-fold wall time, training-size scaling, longest production schedule and safety margins
Miniature actual pipeline executes six new development fits and three production fits; no old reference neural models are refit
Production training indices include every miniature PA row
Rejected candidates retain actual attempted scores and emit NO_SUBMISSION.json, not a submission CSV
Budget exhaustion prevents the next fold and production
Export failure revokes the ready CSV; late failure also revokes report eligibility and invalidates the manifest
Temporary runtime files are removed on success and failure
Five-file export, NPZ role alignment, probability mass, submission cardinality and output hashes are checked
verification.miniature_scope_warning: 32 synthetic CPU rows, 5016 outputs, one epoch, width 16; comparator scores, selected policy and minimum geographic support are controlled to exercise acceptance. These tests validate implementation, not predictive accuracy or full T4 runtime.

compact_output_capacity_check.scope: Actual compact exporter with synthetic random top128 ranks and broad float16 probabilities; reserves for remaining files. Not a measured full Kaggle output.

limitations: No guaranteed leaderboard improvement, 12-hour completion or established SOTA
Cooperative runtime checks cannot preempt stalled hardware or I/O
All 88987 PA surveys were consumed previously; stricter repeated development gates are not fresh independent evidence
The cached comparator is the unchanged v32 recipe refit during v34, not hidden-test labels or the v34 graph predictions
Calibration policy search uses 3000 archived views, not the full historical calibration pool
Pooling, auxiliary ranking, training schedule and full-set decoding change together; component causality is not established
The ranking loss and ratio-of-expectations count decoder are surrogates, not exact expected-F1 optimization
Full-data production calibration transfer and poorly represented test countries remain risks
The full-set model can regress even when all internal gates pass; v32 remains the scored best until an actual new score exceeds it
